title: Oset (staff)
body:
Syntax: oset create <vnum> <name...>  |  oset <vnum> <field> <value...>  |  oset load <vnum>  |  oset list
'oset <vnum> <field> -<value>' removes one entry from a list field instead of adding.

Description: Creates and edits item prototypes field by field. Shops stocking this item's VNUM use the edited name, price, and combat stats immediately. 'oset load <vnum>' places one instance on the ground in the room you're standing in right now, with no persistence -- see 'help spawnpoint' for a version that survives a server restart.

&WText fields:&x short, long, description, itemtype, weapontype, scrolljutsu, rarity, wearloc
  itemtype      -- category (weapon/armor/tool/trash/scroll/material/etc.); drives shop pricing and more
  weapontype    -- kunai/sword/shuriken/blunt/polearm/exotic; sets itemtype weapon and wearloc wielded automatically. Use 'none' to clear it before changing itemtype
  wearloc       -- where this item can be equipped (head/body/legs/feet/hands/waist/finger/neck/piercing/back/chakra aura for armor, or wielded/tool). itemtype weapon/tool auto-fills this if left blank
  rarity         -- common/uncommon/rare/epic/legendary; drives display color everywhere the item's name is shown
  scrolljutsu   -- set alongside itemtype scroll to make this item teach a jutsu on 'read'

&WNumber fields:&x weight, cost, level, condition, setbonuspercent, concap, hitroll, damageroll, damage, heal, healtime, uses
  hitroll/damageroll -- bonuses while wielded; 0 clears the bonus
  damage        -- fixed base damage for this item, overriding the weapontype default (0 or higher)
  heal/healtime -- total restoration per healflag, delivered over this many seconds for a medical item
  uses          -- number of attempts before each copy of a job tool breaks (default 250)

&WList fields:&x keywords, flags, wear, setvnums, healflags
  healflags      -- add health, chakra, or stamina; prefix - to remove one (e.g. -health)
  flags          -- item flags such as 'nosac' or 'notake'; see 'help flags'
  wear           -- item's wear permissions (e.g. take); wearloc chooses the actual slot
  setvnums       -- the OTHER object vnums that must also be worn to complete this item's armor set
  Older underscore field names still work. Type 'oset fields' for the short reference.

&WStat perks:&x 'oset <vnum> statbonus <stat> <n>' remains available for other bonuses such as armor_class; direct 'oset <vnum> hitroll <n>' and 'oset <vnum> damageroll <n>' set the same weapon bonuses. Positive armor_class is beneficial (lower is better). 'ostat' shows Hitroll/Damageroll/Damage for wielded items.
&WArmor:&x 'oset <vnum> resist sword 25' reduces sword weapon damage by 25% while worn. Use any weapontype; 0 clears a resistance. Multiple worn pieces stack. AC still determines hit chance.
&WMedicine:&x set itemtype medical, heal 100, healtime 20, and healflags health (or chakra/stamina). Each flagged resource recovers 100 over 20 seconds, including in combat.

&WValue slots:&x 'oset <vnum> value <index 0-3> <number>' -- 4 raw numeric slots for anything not covered by a named field above.

&WItem programs:&x
  addprogram <vnum> <trigger> <action> <args...>
  removeprogram <vnum> <index>  -- index shown by 'ostat'

Use 'ostat <vnum>' to view the full stat block.

&D(Staff only.)&x

Date: 2026-08-17
